data.title: V1VID Residence
data.about:
V1VID Residence by Object One Development redefines luxury living in Dubai’s sought-after Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT). These exceptional 16-floor building offers studios and 1, 2 and 3 bedroom units designed for a modern lifestyle. The V1VID Residence apartments at JVT feature expansive balconies, high ceilings, and custom-curated wardrobes. Floor-to-ceiling windows and high-quality materials.

The V1VID Residence at JVT location ensures quick access to Dubai's prime hotspots. Packed with world-class amenities, residents enjoy a swimming pool, wellness center, BBQ space, and shaded walkways. The V1VID Residence at JVT amenities include jogging tracks, meditation zones, kids’ play areas, and secure underground parking. With a thoughtfully crafted master plan, the project ensures sustainable living through energy-efficient systems and natural ventilation. Competitive pricing and flexible payment plans make luxury apartments at V1VID Residence at JVT an ideal choice for a range of buyers.

characteristics_module.title: Elevate Your Lifestyle at V1VID Residence JVT.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Modern design: V1VID Residence apartments at JVT feature expansive balconies, custom wardrobes, and floor-to-ceiling windows.  
  • Prime location: Strategically located in Jumeirah Village Triangle, offering seamless connectivity to Dubai's landmarks.  
  • Sustainability: Energy-efficient systems and natural ventilation enhance eco-friendly living.  
  • Versatile floor plans: Studios to 3-bedroom luxury apartments designed for diverse lifestyles.  
    Masterfully planned community: Surrounded by lush greenery and tranquil spaces for relaxation.  
  • World-class amenities: Swimming pool, wellness center, BBQ area, and jogging tracks for a complete lifestyle.  
  • High-quality materials: Elegant interiors with premium finishes and high-quality flooring.

location_tile.title: Prime Location, Seamless Connectivity – Experience the Best of Dubai at V1VID Residence JVT.
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
The location of V1VID Residence at JVT by Object One offers unmatched convenience in Jumeirah Village Triangle, Dubai. Strategically positioned, it places residents within easy driving distance of Dubai’s key attractions and hotspots.  

This prime location enhances connectivity while maintaining a peaceful and green environment. The well-planned infrastructure ensures seamless access to schools, shopping centers, and leisure destinations. V1VID Residence location at JVT combines urban accessibility with tranquil surroundings, creating the perfect balance for a modern lifestyle.
